g.text: 2026 El Niño: Seasonal RO and Reconstructed PMM

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9b4335

g.text: February–June monthly-state initializations; leads 1–9 months. Skill uses 25 observed Niño3.4 pairs; lead 0 is not scored.
PMM = ERSSTv5 SST projection onto the fixed R1 MCA mode (1950–2005); reconstructed extension beyond official PMM.
Path arrows indicate time; all states, including PMM, evolve freely. Dotted phase segments extend beyond observed WWV.
Observed SST through Sep 2026; WWV through Aug 2026. Shaded time range is unverified and excluded from skill.
WWV proxy: GODAS mean D20. Shared scales: σT = 0.852 °C; σh = 5.536 m. Detrended manuscript coordinates.
